title: Ad click billing: a stream consumer that commits past failures
name: Click billing consumer

questions.prompt: Finance reconciled November invoices against the raw click logs and found a few hundred clicks that were never billed, all around the times the ledger database logged deadlocks. The billing consumer logged each failure ("deadlock detected writing clk-..."), but those clicks never appear in the ledger, even after the consumer kept running for hours. Fix the click consumer so the tests pass. Keep billing batches in parallel.
